dct_description_sm: Western blots of various autophagy related proteins. Canine osteosarcoma and control cell lines we treated with spautin-1 +/- doxorubicin and protein was collected and run on an SDS-PAGE gel. The western blots are related to Figure 3 in the article Schott et al. (2018). The autophagy inhibitor spautin-1, either alone or combined with doxorubicin, decreases cell survival and colony formation in canine appendicular osteosarcoma cells. PLoS One.
